status: preregistered before scientific training; implementation hashes appended at engineering gate
purpose: Input codec by capacity timing comparison in the published tiny unary domain; shared response grammar. Not a complete native-output codec/system-cost benchmark.

curriculum.order: np.default_rng(seed+350000+1000*stage.index); repeatedly shuffle the whole(op,value) block then truncate at a full-lesson MAC boundary, identical ordinal stream across arms
curriculum.student_features: only actual raw binary question concatenated with current answer prefix; no profile, AST, role, length, boundary or answer oracle feature
curriculum.answer: shared P031 native SLE data word: n_data information bits + 0; external model action S terminates generation
curriculum.teacher_forcing: correct answer prefix in training; own prior outputs in free generation
curriculum.holdout_use: predeclared diagnostics only; no budget, curriculum, stopping or parameter decisions

model.initialization: original P030: W_in N(0,.2), W_out N(0,.15), biases0, float32
model.optimizer: original P030 Adam lr=.003 betas .9/.999 eps1e-8; global norm clip1; per-coordinate birth age
model.growth: original P030: preserve old p/m/v/birth/t; random incoming, zero new hidden outgoing; all coordinates trainable after growth
model.F_initialization: same seed/minimum student, replay the entire prescribed L/H growth sequence at t0 before any training
model.G_initialization: same seed/minimum student, grow only on entry to each prescribed semantic stage

budget.unit: training dense matrix MAC; not hardware total FLOPs
budget.per_stage: exactly 3000 Fixed-final lessons equivalent; use stage caps, no carry
budget.boundary: complete lessons only; next lesson not executed if it would exceed cap; leftover recorded, no fake optimizer/no-op updates
budget.inference_and_engineering_costs: recorded separately; excluded from primary training MAC cap
budget.wall_time: record only; no hardware-dependent scientific stopping rule

primary.evaluation_profile: final op2/data3, no END, current format for all prior semantics
milestones: Echo and Neg values 0..7 all correct
primary.score: highest consecutive cumulative milestone passed, integer0..4; whole free generation including correct S and no overflow
primary.representation_transition: op1->op2 is diagnosed separately, not counted again as a semantic skill
primary.interpretation: three paired seeds are descriptive, nested milestones are not independent skills; SG-best alone does not show encoding-specific growth benefit

diagnostics.training_fit: each100 complete lessons, plus stage endpoint; first observed three consecutive train/val all-correct checks, diagnostic only
diagnostics.checkpoint: all p/m/v/birth,t,L,H,growth_rng; exact trace and complete independent deterministic replay
diagnostics.growth: same raw old valid prefixes logit preservation plus old arrays/moments/age equality; current-format adaptation measured separately
diagnostics.predictions: per-op/train/val/test whole, teacher-forcing, free-run bits/STOP/first-error, logits, malformed/overflow
diagnostics.drift: old overlapping parameter and optimizer blocks before/after each stage, joint with functional retention
diagnostics.exposure: value,op-value,width-sensitive semantics and cross-stage ledger; no recoded-seen cases called novel
diagnostics.snapshot_boundary: last completed lesson at or below each stage-MAC fraction, with requested threshold and actual spent MAC recorded

limitations: same published 1..3-bit domain, not new blind evaluation
d1/d2 exhaustive teaching has no holdout
H supports a declared compact unary hierarchical slice, not arbitrary recursive grammar
common response grammar deliberately controls output-side learning; not H's shortest possible native output
equal MAC lets G see more lessons, an intentional capacity-policy resource effect; not an isolated parameter-copy mechanism
no attention tuning, new operations, ritual, neural translation or real VM execution
engineering_gate: codec/oracle/invalid-input/tensor audit plus runner state/growth/MAC/replay checks and independent review; freeze source hashes before all12
nvidia: one public read-only review; actual response and deterministic acceptance/rejection recorded separately; no opinion treated as PASS
stop: complete the12 frozen runs once plus deterministic replays; no outcome-driven changes, added seeds or extensions
